name: MPB original terminal shovel crop plus plot - NOT RUN
preconditions: Run only after the all-coding gate in a disposable save. Guard stays ON. Prepare a neutral-yield farming owner with a shovel in slot1, one activated farm plot at14,45,995 at MaxDamage-1 and mature player-grown corn at14,46,995. Clear original crop/plot receipts, not real player data, by using a fresh disposable baseline. Warm original source identity with a nonterminal earlier hit before setting the final damage. Leave room for both outputs. Native neutral plot yield is1; crop yield may be0..3. This flow asserts one original terminal input and no additional-hit requirement. Independent remote/fullbag/crash variants remain separate batch cases. Coordinates are a fixed disposable fixture, never production setup.
acceptanceCases: NOT_RUN: two independent native owners capture the same actual crop incarnation. Only the first reserved original may mutate the crop/terminal plot or receive its frozen yield; the positively unspent loser is refused while the first reservation still exists, without reroll, source replay or inventory rollback.

NOT_RUN: reservation memory claims source BEFORE journal publication. Denied/uncertain publication, exact staged claim, backup, reload and competing owner cannot make the source appear unclaimed. Valid prepared stages hold only; partial/conflicting stages quarantine admission and cannot grant native effect permission.

NOT_RUN: only exact retained same-original claim plus authenticated saved unspent native owner frame may retry pure prepared journal publication. Native source mutation needs its separate durable attempt and actual final-run Chunk.SetBlock observation.

NOT_RUN: skipped original with equal destination, thrown original without accepted chunk event, changed incarnation/block/plot/other owner, nested repeated mutation or interrupted source attempt cannot be restamped from equality or replayed. One actual observed mutation plus saved native chunk publication is mandatory before yield delivery.

NOT_RUN: actual native owner SetItem must accept exact same value and full bag/belt/cursor postimage for every changed yield cell. Prefix-only permit, another-prefix write with final original skipped, unrelated slot change, wrong original plan and failed durable accepted receipt cannot advance phase2.

NOT_RUN: positive skipped native cell with full unchanged before permits a bounded later attempt; throwing/unknown cell never replays. Partial accepted cells resume using their exact durable native events, never equality alone. Receipt publication retry does not repeat a setter or harvest RNG.

NOT_RUN: full inventory routes the immutable remaining yield through existing actual native drop-child saved publications. Reconnect/reload restores same original record/capsule and published cell membership. Late loser/old reply cannot take winner yield; replaced/regrown crop is a distinct native incarnation. Missing/unresolved effect proof retains custody without compensating yield.

NOT_RUN: native owner action wear/stamina finishes before frozen delivery plan; native yield, replant/provenance, remote original base count, overflow and existing native quest/XP/statistics callback boundaries remain in their original actor lanes.
